answer: A concrete Sybil defence is bond slashing at admission: each new identity locks stake before submitting work, and peers can burn it if two accounts claiming separate operators act in lockstep. Every fake account then carries a real unrecoverable cost, so thousands of puppets cost thousands of bonds, not one. Attestation paths add a gate: a forged voucher drags the real voucher's bond into slashable range, turning farming into shared loss. Reputation accrues slowly in a signed quill no duplicate can copy, so a fake summit of names buys nothing, and an honest grove stays cheap.
